output.notes: Described the base Transformer (EN-DE); big config also listed. The block_ops show one decoder layer without its cross-attention sublayer, which is listed under mechanisms_outside_ir; encoder layers are the same without the causal mask. Vocab of 37000 is approximate ('about'); EN-FR uses 32000. Big head_dim of 64 comes from 'unlisted values identical to base'. The attention scale of 0.125 and embedding scale of 22.627417 are computed from 1/sqrt(d_k) and sqrt(d_model). Left not_stated: projection biases, LayerNorm eps and context length.
